authorization.exact_user_instruction: Anyways, do what you need to do to get the current demo cdata
authorization.interpretation: Fresh guarded current demo measurement authorized; does not assert that the external build has finished. Strict process guards still apply.

source_and_build_provenance.changes: Python orchestration only: new authorization gate, demo only, four fonts, DPI2, stable-index balanced AB/BA ordering, raw failure/guard retention, complete sequence totals and paired absolute intervals; Rust source/binaries unchanged.
source_and_build_provenance.root_verification: Root owns current source/build verification and timing execution; --code-ready records that GO.

metrics.primary: first_paint total_us, one frame per independent process
metrics.scope: Actual byte-preserved demo adapter CPU drawing includes Canvas set_size, text layout and other scene work; total adds Void flush; fonts/images/setup excluded; no GPU/window/presentation/app-startup measurement.

statistics.estimator: median of whole-block paired differences and ratios; marginal medians shown separately
statistics.interval: percentile sorted indices250/9750 with shared whole-block resamples across endpoints

policy.trigger: any build/compiler/linker process-name match; metadata/version matches remain excluded
policy.retention: attempts.jsonl contains every completed/failed process, raw.jsonl contains only accepted whole blocks, excluded-raw.jsonl preserves rejected/failed block records; ledger records empty attempts too
